- **Writes are permitted only under `.rust-queue/reports/`.** Repository source, the `.rust-queue/` root, shell, `grep`, and `web_fetch` all return the same boundary error. So the source patch is **drafted, not applied**, no command was executed, and live issue/PR activity could not be re-fetched.

I bound the layout to the **actual C++ representation** in `score/mw/com/impl/methods/method_signature_element_ptr.h` — `MethodInArgPtr<T> = MethodSignatureElementPtr<T>` with members `SignatureElement* element_ptr_; bool& ptr_active_; std::size_t queue_position_;` → Rust `*mut T` / `*mut bool` / `usize` (24 B, align 8, independent of `T`). - **`_probe.txt`** — unavoidable write-capability probe artifact (could not be deleted).
